adjusted_volatile_messages: Prepare the requested reusable draft without executing any operation.
composition_summary: Drafted one unapproved pure-logic class22 component pc-transfer-03. Raw lag may be absent or any JSON value; accepts exact integers -1..8 inclusive, rejecting bool/float/missing/null/out-of-range. Helper classify_lag receives the mapping, checks presence first (missing and null both yield accepted=false, lag=null), then exact int type and range, returning {accepted,lag} on every path. Module scope invokes it and assigns its returned object to result. No imports, I/O, host calls, Tool dispatch, submission, Q1/Q2 or activation. Target typed inputs requires selected-runner support.

payload.name: pc-transfer-03
payload.description: Raw lag may omit or contain any JSON value. Accept exact integers -1..8 inclusive (not bool/float). Always result={accepted:boolean,lag:original if accepted else null}; invalid/missing return false/null without exceptions or coercion. Helper receives the mapping, module invokes it and assigns its returned object to result. Unapproved target typed-inputs draft; selected-runner support, Q1 and human Q2 required.
